source.text_anchor: Procedure: Contrast-Enhanced CT Chest, Abdomen, and Pelvis (IV contrast administered).

imaging_reports.report_text: Lower Neck / Thyroid: Visualized thyroid gland is unremarkable without nodules. Mediastinum & Hila: No pathological lymphadenopathy detected in mediastinum or hilar stations. Pleural Spaces: No pleural effusions or pleural thickening identified bilaterally.

imaging_reports.body_site: Breast & Chest Wall, Lungs, Abdomen, Pelvis, Bones
imaging_reports.report_text: 2.2 cm discrete non-calcified mass in upper-outer quadrant of right breast. Underlying pectoralis major muscle plane is preserved without direct invasion. Left breast unremarkable. Lungs: No focal lesions in lung parenchyma. Tracheobronchial tree is clear. Abdomen: Liver is normal in size and attenuation; no focal lesions. Spleen, pancreas, adrenal glands, and kidneys unremarkable. Pelvis: Bladder and pelvic organs unremarkable. No pelvic free fluid. No pathological lymphadenopathy detected in retroperitoneum. Bones: No focal destructive or blastic lesions in osseous structures.
